about_the_game:
Voxel-based 3d Building System

All conveyors and facilities in the game are voxel-aligned, so you don’t have to worry about misaligned issues. Let your imagination run wild and build your dream 3D factory!

Automated Alchemy Laboratory

Grinding herbs, extracting essential oils, distilling potions, and even transmuting stones into gold — all of them are automatically handled in the alchemy lab you build.

Liquid & Pipe System

A wide variety of liquids are undoubtedly the soul of alchemy — they can be transported through pipe systems to every corner of your factory.

Shop Management & Simulation

Don’t forget to put your products on the shelves to earn profits! As the game progresses, the entire sales process can also be fully automated — and honestly, what’s better than making money while kicking back and relaxing?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later (64-Bit)
  • Processor: i5-3570 3.4 GHz 4 Core
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1060, or AMD RX 470/RX 570, or equivalent performance & VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 or later (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Ryzen 5 5600X﻿ or ﻿i5-12400 ﻿or equivalent performance, 6 physical cores minimum
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 2070﻿ or RX 5700, or equivalent performance & VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

short_description: "Alchemy Factory" is a first-person factory building & shop simulation game. You'll process raw materials, research new recipes, and build fully automated production lines to craft and sell a wide range of alchemical products.
